This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This was a bug causing report listing pagination to overlap when reports were created simultaneously. The cause was fixed in version 3.2.1 by ordering reports also by ID, preventing duplicates across pages. The reporter confirmed the upgrade to 3.2.1 resolves the issue; the bug is fixed in that version.
